description: Sets the dates aside for 2 hours and emails the guest a link. The guest opens it, reads the payment and cancellation terms, and accepts; only then are the dates held, for 72 hours, and the itemized invoice sent. Nothing is charged. Use the guest's own name and email address, with their permission, after get_quote: the email goes to them, and the house will reply there. One open request per email address at a time.

add_ons.description: Optional add-on codes from get_quote's add_ons_available (boat tour, spa, bonfire, ...); priced for the whole party.

check_in.description: Arrival date, YYYY-MM-DD. Arrival is from 2pm.

check_out.description: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD. Departure is by noon.

children.description: Children aged 4 to 11. Adults and children together may not exceed 20.

email.description: The guest's email address; the confirmation link goes here.

message.description: Optional note for the house: the occasion, arrival plans, what the group loves.

phone.description: Optional phone number, with country code.

toddlers.description: Children under 4: free, and not counted toward the 20.

name: request_hold
title: Hold dates for the guest
